g.title: GreenGridJoinFlow
g.text: GREENGRID ENERGY | DATA JOIN & OPERATIONAL KPI PIPELINE

g.title: cluster_sources
g.text: CLEANED SOURCE FILES | join each table at its own grain

g.title: wxjoin
g.text: Mapping assigns station_id to each asset
Never join weather by timestamp alone

g.title: regional
g.text: Join EMS + BESS on timestamp + region
Calculate absorption capacity, modeled output and curtailment

g.title: system
g.text: Aggregate asset-hour to one row / hour
Join EMS and market price on timestamp
Calculate surplus, renewable share, curtailment value proxies

g.title: dispatchhour
g.text: Expand each event start–end to hourly rows
Append event metadata after model calculations

g.title: alloc
g.text: Join regional model back to asset-hour
Allocate by each asset's share of potential generation
